input.content:
--[[
	BlobSpawner (Script)
	Put this in ServerScriptService.

	Puts each player's equipped blob into the world:
	  • Spawns it next to the player when they spawn, and again after respawning
	  • Sizes it by level: baby size at level 1, full size at its FullGrowthLevel
	  • Adds a name tag above it: name, level badge and an XP bar
	  • Updates the tag and size whenever the blob levels up or gets renamed
	  • Removes it when the player leaves

	The server only creates and sizes the blob. The BlobFollow LocalScript
	moves it on each player's screen, which keeps the movement smooth.
]]

local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local ServerScriptService = game:GetService("ServerScriptService")

local DataManager = require(ServerScriptService:WaitForChild("DataManager"))
local BlobDefinitions = require(ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("BlobDefinitions"))

local CHECK_INTERVAL = 1 -- seconds between "is the right blob out?" checks

local COLORS = {
	tagBackground = Color3.fromRGB(24, 26, 34),
	barBackground = Color3.fromRGB(50, 54, 66),
	barFill       = Color3.fromRGB(96, 214, 120),
	levelBadge    = Color3.fromRGB(255, 196, 64),
	levelText     = Color3.fromRGB(60, 40, 0),
	text          = Color3.new(1, 1, 1),
	subText       = Color3.fromRGB(200, 205, 220),
}

-- Folder that holds every active blob in the world
local folder = workspace:FindFirstChild("ActiveBlobs")
if not folder then
	folder = Instance.new("Folder")
	folder.Name = "ActiveBlobs"
	folder.Parent = workspace
end

local active = {} -- [player] = { model, blobId, fullScale, tag parts }

---------------------------------------------------------------------
-- NAME TAG
---------------------------------------------------------------------
local function new(className, props, children)
	local inst = Instance.new(className)
	for key, value in pairs(props or {}) do
		inst[key] = value
	end
	for _, child in ipairs(children or {}) do
		child.Parent = inst
	end
	return inst
end

local function buildTag(adornee)
	local tag = new("BillboardGui", {
		Name = "BlobTag",
		Adornee = adornee,
		Size = UDim2.new(0, 170, 0, 58),
		StudsOffsetWorldSpace = Vector3.new(0, 1.5, 0),
		LightInfluence = 0,
		MaxDistance = 80,
		ResetOnSpawn = false,
	})

	local nameLabel = new("TextLabel", {
		Name = "BlobName",
		BackgroundTransparency = 1,
		Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 24),
		Font = Enum.Font.FredokaOne,
		TextColor3 = COLORS.text,
		TextScaled = true,
		TextStrokeTransparency = 0.4,
		Text = "",
	})
	nameLabel.Parent = tag

	local row = new("Frame", {
		Name = "LevelRow",
		Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 28),
		Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 26),
		BackgroundColor3 = COLORS.tagBackground,
		BackgroundTransparency = 0.2,
	}, {
		new("UICorner", { CornerRadius = UDim.new(1, 0) }),
	})
	row.Parent = tag

	local badge = new("TextLabel", {
		Name = "Level",
		Position = UDim2.new(0, 3, 0.5, 0),
		AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0, 0.5),
		Size = UDim2.new(0, 46, 0, 20),
		BackgroundColor3 = COLORS.levelBadge,
		Font = Enum.Font.FredokaOne,
		TextColor3 = COLORS.levelText,
		TextSize = 14,
		Text = "Lv 1",
	}, {
		new("UICorner", { CornerRadius = UDim.new(1, 0) }),
	})
	badge.Parent = row

	local bar = new("Frame", {
		Name = "Bar",
		Position = UDim2.new(0, 54, 0.5, 0),
		AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0, 0.5),
		Size = UDim2.new(1, -60, 0, 16),
		BackgroundColor3 = COLORS.barBackground,
		ClipsDescendants = true,
	}, {
		new("UICorner", { CornerRadius = UDim.new(1, 0) }),
	})
	bar.Parent = row

	local fill = new("Frame", {
		Name = "Fill",
		Size = UDim2.new(0, 0, 1, 0),
		BackgroundColor3 = COLORS.barFill,
	}, {
		new("UICorner", { CornerRadius = UDim.new(1, 0) }),
	})
	fill.Parent = bar

	local xpLabel = new("TextLabel", {
		Name = "XP",
		BackgroundTransparency = 1,
		Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1),
		Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold,
		TextColor3 = COLORS.text,
		TextStrokeTransparency = 0.5,
		TextSize = 11,
		Text = "",
		ZIndex = 2,
	})
	xpLabel.Parent = bar

	return tag, {
		name = nameLabel,
		level = badge,
		fill = fill,
		xp = xpLabel,
	}
end

---------------------------------------------------------------------
-- SPAWNING
---------------------------------------------------------------------
local function despawn(player)
	local entry = active[player]
	if entry then
		if entry.model then entry.model:Destroy() end
		active[player] = nil
	end
end

-- Updates the tag text, XP bar, size and attributes from the saved blob
local function refresh(player)
	local entry = active[player]
	if not entry then return end
	local blob = DataManager.GetBlob(player, entry.blobId)
	if not blob then return end
	local def = BlobDefinitions.Get(blob.Type)

	-- Name and level
	local displayName = (blob.Nickname ~= "" and blob.Nickname) or (def and def.DisplayName) or blob.Type
	entry.labels.name.Text = displayName
	entry.labels.level.Text = "Lv " .. blob.Level

	-- XP bar
	if blob.Level >= BlobDefinitions.MaxLevel then
		entry.labels.fill.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 1, 0)
		entry.labels.xp.Text = "MAX"
	else
		local needed = BlobDefinitions.XPToNextLevel(blob.Level)
		local progress = math.clamp(blob.XP / needed, 0, 1)
		entry.labels.fill.Size = UDim2.new(progress, 0, 1, 0)
		entry.labels.xp.Text = ("%d / %d XP"):format(blob.XP, needed)
	end

	-- Size grows with level until fully grown
	local scale = entry.fullScale * BlobDefinitions.GetSizeScale(blob.Type, blob.Level)
	if math.abs(entry.model:GetScale() - scale) > 0.001 then
		entry.model:ScaleTo(scale)
	end

	entry.model:SetAttribute("Level", blob.Level)
	entry.model:SetAttribute("DisplayName", displayName)
end

local function spawnBlob(player)
	despawn(player)

	local data = DataManager.Get(player)
	if not data or data.EquippedBlobId == "" then return end
	local blob = data.Blobs[data.EquippedBlobId]
	if not blob then return end

	local character = player.Character
	local root = character and character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
	if not root then return end

	local def = BlobDefinitions.Get(blob.Type)
	local template = BlobDefinitions.GetModel(blob.Type)
	if not def or not template or not template:IsA("Model") or not template.PrimaryPart then
		warn(("[BlobSpawner] Can't spawn %s for %s: check its model in BlobModels"):format(blob.Type, player.Name))
		return
	end

	local model = template:Clone()
	model.Name = player.Name .. "_Blob"
	for _, d in ipairs(model:GetDescendants()) do
		if d:IsA("BaseScript") then
			d:Destroy()
		elseif d:IsA("BasePart") then
			d.Anchored = true
			d.CanCollide = false
			d.CanTouch = false
			d.CanQuery = false
		end
	end
	model.ModelStreamingMode = Enum.ModelStreamingMode.Atomic

	-- Size at which this blob is fully grown (FullSize studs tall)
	local bottom, top = BlobDefinitions.GetWorldBounds(model)
	local fullScale = model:GetScale() * (def.FullSize / math.max(top - bottom, 0.1))

	-- Info the BlobFollow LocalScript uses to move it
	model:SetAttribute("OwnerUserId", player.UserId)
	model:SetAttribute("BlobId", blob.Id)
	model:SetAttribute("BlobType", blob.Type)
	model:SetAttribute("BuiltPose", template:GetPivot().Rotation)

	-- Start beside the player
	local start = root.Position - root.CFrame.LookVector * 5 + root.CFrame.RightVector * 3
	model:PivotTo(CFrame.new(start) * template:GetPivot().Rotation)

	local tag, labels = buildTag(model.PrimaryPart)
	tag.Parent = model

	active[player] = {
		model = model,
		blobId = blob.Id,
		fullScale = fullScale,
		labels = labels,
	}
	refresh(player)
	model.Parent = folder
end

---------------------------------------------------------------------
-- KEEPING THE RIGHT BLOB OUT
---------------------------------------------------------------------
DataManager.BlobChanged:Connect(function(player, blobId)
	local entry = active[player]
	if entry and entry.blobId == blobId then
		refresh(player)
	end
end)

local function onCharacter(player)
	task.wait(0.5) -- let the plot script move them onto their plot first
	if player.Parent then
		spawnBlob(player)
	end
end

local function onPlayerAdded(player)
	player.CharacterAdded:Connect(function()
		onCharacter(player)
	end)
	player.CharacterRemoving:Connect(function()
		despawn(player)
	end)
end

Players.PlayerAdded:Connect(onPlayerAdded)
Players.PlayerRemoving:Connect(despawn)
for _, player in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
	onPlayerAdded(player)
end

-- Every second: make sure each player has their equipped blob out.
-- This catches a blob hatched after spawning, or a newly equipped one.
task.spawn(function()
	while true do
		task.wait(CHECK_INTERVAL)
		for _, player in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
			local data = DataManager.Get(player)
			if data and player.Character then
				local entry = active[player]
				local wanted = data.EquippedBlobId
				if wanted ~= "" and (not entry or entry.blobId ~= wanted or not entry.model.Parent) then
					spawnBlob(player)
				elseif wanted == "" and entry then
					despawn(player)
				end
			end
		end
	end
end)

	movement smooth instead of choppy):
	  • Each blob follows behind its owner, a little to the side
	  • It sticks to the ground, turns to face where it's going,
	    and faces its owner when standing still
	  • Each blob moves in its own MovementStyle from BlobDefinitions:
	      Hop, Bounce, Roll, Slither, Wobble or Hover
	  • If a blob falls too far behind (teleport, respawn), it catches up instantly
	  • Your own blob stays hidden while your egg is hatching, then pops out
	    right where the egg was
]]

local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")

local BlobDefinitions = require(ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("BlobDefinitions"))

local player = Players.LocalPlayer
local folder = workspace:WaitForChild("ActiveBlobs")

---------------------------------------------------------------------
-- SETTINGS
---------------------------------------------------------------------
local FOLLOW_BEHIND   = 5    -- studs behind the owner
local FOLLOW_SIDE     = 3.5  -- studs to the owner's right
local MAX_SPEED       = 30   -- fastest a blob can move (studs per second)
local CATCH_UP        = 4    -- higher = sticks closer to the owner
local TURN_SPEED      = 8    -- how quickly it turns to face a new direction
local TELEPORT_RANGE  = 60   -- further than this away = teleport to the owner

---------------------------------------------------------------------
-- HELPERS
---------------------------------------------------------------------
local rayParams = RaycastParams.new()
rayParams.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude

local function updateRayFilter()
	local ignore = { folder }
	for _, p in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
		if p.Character then table.insert(ignore, p.Character) end
	end
	rayParams.FilterDescendantsInstances = ignore
end

local function groundHeight(position, fallback)
	local result = workspace:Raycast(position + Vector3.new(0, 8, 0), Vector3.new(0, -40, 0), rayParams)
	return result and result.Position.Y or fallback
end

-- Smallest difference between two angles (so turning never goes the long way round)
local function angleDelta(from, to)
	return (to - from + math.pi) % (2 * math.pi) - math.pi
end

local function yawFacing(direction)
	return math.atan2(-direction.X, -direction.Z)
end

local function setHidden(model, hidden)
	for _, d in ipairs(model:GetDescendants()) do
		if d:IsA("BasePart") or d:IsA("Decal") or d:IsA("Texture") then
			d.LocalTransparencyModifier = hidden and 1 or 0
		elseif d:IsA("BillboardGui") then
			d.Enabled = not hidden
		end
	end
end

---------------------------------------------------------------------
-- PER-BLOB STATE
---------------------------------------------------------------------
local blobs = {} -- [model] = state

local function measure(state)
	-- How far the pivot sits above the blob's lowest point, at its current size
	local model = state.model
	model:PivotTo(state.turn * state.builtPose)
	local bottom, top = BlobDefinitions.GetWorldBounds(model)
	state.pivotToBottom = -bottom
	state.height = math.max(top - bottom, 0.5)
	state.scale = model:GetScale()
end

local function track(model)
	if blobs[model] then return end
	if not model:IsA("Model") then return end

	local blobType = model:GetAttribute("BlobType")
	local def = blobType and BlobDefinitions.Get(blobType)
	if not def then return end

	local state = {
		model = model,
		owner = Players:GetPlayerByUserId(model:GetAttribute("OwnerUserId") or 0),
		style = def.MovementStyle or "Hop",
		builtPose = model:GetAttribute("BuiltPose") or CFrame.identity,
		turn = BlobDefinitions.GetFacingRotation(blobType),
		position = model:GetPivot().Position,
		groundY = nil,
		yaw = 0,
		phase = math.random() * 10,
		roll = 0,
		hidden = false,
	}
	measure(state)
	blobs[model] = state
end

folder.ChildAdded:Connect(function(model)
	task.defer(track, model)
end)
folder.ChildRemoved:Connect(function(model)
	blobs[model] = nil
end)
for _, model in ipairs(folder:GetChildren()) do
	track(model)
end

---------------------------------------------------------------------
-- MOVEMENT STYLES
---------------------------------------------------------------------
--[[
	Each style returns:
	  lift     : studs above the ground
	  tilt     : extra rotation (in the blob's own facing direction)
	  extraYaw : extra left/right turn
	  side     : sideways shuffle (studs)
	`k` is the blob's height divided by 4, so bigger blobs move bigger.
]]
local STYLES = {}

STYLES.Hop = function(s, moving, t, k)
	if moving then
		return math.abs(math.sin(s.phase * 7)) * 1.2 * k, CFrame.identity, 0, 0
	end
	-- Idle: an occasional little hop
	local hop = math.max(0, math.sin(t * 2.2)) ^ 6
	return hop * 0.5 * k, CFrame.identity, 0, 0
end

STYLES.Bounce = function(s, moving, t, k)
	if moving then
		return math.abs(math.sin(s.phase * 9)) * 1.8 * k, CFrame.identity, 0, 0
	end
	-- Idle: can't sit still
	return math.abs(math.sin(t * 4)) * 0.35 * k, CFrame.identity, 0, 0
end

STYLES.Roll = function(s, moving, t, k)
	-- Rotates forward as it travels, like a ball
	return 0, CFrame.Angles(-s.roll, 0, 0), 0, 0
end

STYLES.Slither = function(s, moving, t, k)
	if moving then
		local wave = math.sin(s.phase * 6)
		return 0, CFrame.identity, wave * 0.35, wave * 0.4 * k
	end
	return 0, CFrame.identity, math.sin(t * 1.5) * 0.1, 0
end

STYLES.Wobble = function(s, moving, t, k)
	if moving then
		return 0, CFrame.Angles(0, 0, math.sin(s.phase * 5) * 0.22), 0, 0
	end
	return 0, CFrame.Angles(0, 0, math.sin(t * 2) * 0.06), 0, 0
end

STYLES.Hover = function(s, moving, t, k)
	local float = 1.2 * k + math.sin(t * 2) * 0.25 * k
	local lean = moving and CFrame.Angles(-0.2, 0, 0) or CFrame.identity
	return float, lean, 0, 0
end

---------------------------------------------------------------------
-- EVERY FRAME
---------------------------------------------------------------------
local rayTimer = 0

RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function(dt)
	dt = math.min(dt, 0.1)
	rayTimer -= dt
	if rayTimer <= 0 then
		rayTimer = 1
		updateRayFilter()
	end
	local t = os.clock()

	for model, s in pairs(blobs) do
		if not model.Parent or not model.PrimaryPart then
			blobs[model] = nil
			continue
		end

		local owner = s.owner
		local root = owner and owner.Character and owner.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
		if not root then continue end

		-- Your own blob hides while your egg hatches, then appears where the egg was
		if owner == player then
			local hatching = player:GetAttribute("Hatching") == true
			if hatching ~= s.hidden then
				s.hidden = hatching
				setHidden(model, hatching)
				local spot = player:GetAttribute("HatchSpot")
				if not hatching and typeof(spot) == "Vector3" then
					s.position = spot
					player:SetAttribute("HatchSpot", nil)
				end
			end
			if hatching then continue end
		end

		-- Re-measure if the server changed its size (it levelled up)
		if math.abs(model:GetScale() - s.scale) > 0.001 then
			measure(s)
		end

		-- Where it wants to be: behind and to the side of its owner
		local look = Vector3.new(root.CFrame.LookVector.X, 0, root.CFrame.LookVector.Z)
		if look.Magnitude < 0.01 then look = Vector3.new(0, 0, -1) end
		look = look.Unit
		local right = Vector3.new(-look.Z, 0, look.X)
		local target = root.Position - look * FOLLOW_BEHIND + right * FOLLOW_SIDE

		local flatOffset = Vector3.new(target.X - s.position.X, 0, target.Z - s.position.Z)
		local distance = flatOffset.Magnitude
		if distance > TELEPORT_RANGE then
			s.position = target
			s.groundY = nil
			flatOffset, distance = Vector3.zero, 0
		end

		-- Move toward the target, faster when further away
		local step = 0
		if distance > 0.3 then
			step = math.min(distance, math.min(distance * CATCH_UP, MAX_SPEED) * dt)
			s.position += flatOffset.Unit * step
		end
		local speed = step / dt
		local moving = speed > 1.5

		-- Turn to face where it's going, or its owner when standing still
		local faceDir = moving and flatOffset
			or Vector3.new(root.Position.X - s.position.X, 0, root.Position.Z - s.position.Z)
		if faceDir.Magnitude > 0.05 then
			s.yaw += angleDelta(s.yaw, yawFacing(faceDir)) * math.min(1, dt * TURN_SPEED)
		end

		-- Animation progress only advances while moving
		s.phase += dt * math.clamp(speed / 8, moving and 0.6 or 0, 2)
		s.roll += step / math.max(s.height / 2, 0.5)

		-- Stick to the ground (smoothly, so steps aren't jerky)
		local ground = groundHeight(s.position, root.Position.Y - 3)
		s.groundY = s.groundY and (s.groundY + (ground - s.groundY) * math.min(1, dt * 15)) or ground

		local k = s.height / 4
		local style = STYLES[s.style] or STYLES.Hop
		local lift, tilt, extraYaw, side = style(s, moving, t, k)

		local facing = CFrame.Angles(0, s.yaw + extraYaw, 0)
		local sideOffset = facing.RightVector * side
		local position = Vector3.new(s.position.X, s.groundY + s.pivotToBottom + lift, s.position.Z) + sideOffset
		model:PivotTo(CFrame.new(position) * facing * tilt * s.turn * s.builtPose)
	end
end)

--[[
	PlotXP (Script)
	Put this in ServerScriptService.

	Blobs slowly earn XP while they're on their owner's plot, and nothing
	anywhere else:
	  • "Stay on farm" mode: the blob is always home, so it always earns
	  • "Follow me" mode: it earns only while its owner is standing on the plot

	Also sets the player attribute "EarningXP" (true/false), which the
	buttons at the bottom of the screen use to show whether XP is coming in.
]]

local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")
local ServerScriptService = game:GetService("ServerScriptService")

local DataManager = require(ServerScriptService:WaitForChild("DataManager"))

---------------------------------------------------------------------
-- SETTINGS
---------------------------------------------------------------------
local XP_AMOUNT   = 2  -- XP given each tick while on the plot
local XP_INTERVAL = 5  -- seconds between ticks

-- STUDIO ONLY: multiplies the XP above so you can test leveling faster.
-- Has no effect in the real game. Set to 1 to test the real speed.
local STUDIO_XP_BOOST = 5

---------------------------------------------------------------------
local boost = RunService:IsStudio() and STUDIO_XP_BOOST or 1

-- Is this world position inside the player's plot?
local function isOnPlot(player, position)
	local plotCFrame = player:GetAttribute("PlotCFrame")
	local plotSize = player:GetAttribute("PlotSize")
	if typeof(plotCFrame) ~= "CFrame" or not plotSize then
		return false
	end
	local localPos = plotCFrame:PointToObjectSpace(position)
	local half = plotSize / 2
	return math.abs(localPos.X) <= half and math.abs(localPos.Z) <= half and localPos.Y > -5
end

local function blobIsHome(player, data)
	if data.Settings.BlobMode == "Farm" then
		return player:GetAttribute("PlotCFrame") ~= nil
	end
	local root = player.Character and player.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
	return root ~= nil and isOnPlot(player, root.Position)
end

while true do
	task.wait(XP_INTERVAL)
	for _, player in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
		local data = DataManager.Get(player)
		if data then
			local blobId = data.EquippedBlobId
			local earning = blobId ~= "" and blobIsHome(player, data)

			if player:GetAttribute("EarningXP") ~= earning then
				player:SetAttribute("EarningXP", earning)
			end

			if earning then
				DataManager.AddXP(player, blobId, XP_AMOUNT * boost)
			end
		end
	end
end

--[[
	BlobControls (LocalScript)
	Put this in StarterPlayer > StarterPlayerScripts.

	The buttons at the bottom of the screen:
	  [ Follow me ]  [ Stay on farm ]
	plus a small label above them showing whether your blob is earning XP.

	Only shows up once you have a blob, and hides while an egg is hatching.
]]

local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local TweenService = game:GetService("TweenService")

local setBlobMode = ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("Remotes"):WaitForChild("SetBlobMode")
local player = Players.LocalPlayer

---------------------------------------------------------------------
-- SETTINGS
---------------------------------------------------------------------
local COLORS = {
	panel        = Color3.fromRGB(24, 26, 34),
	selected     = Color3.fromRGB(88, 196, 108),
	unselected   = Color3.fromRGB(44, 47, 58),
	textOn       = Color3.new(1, 1, 1),
	textOff      = Color3.fromRGB(170, 175, 190),
	earning      = Color3.fromRGB(120, 230, 140),
	notEarning   = Color3.fromRGB(170, 175, 190),
}

---------------------------------------------------------------------
-- BUILD THE UI
---------------------------------------------------------------------
local function new(className, props, children)
	local inst = Instance.new(className)
	for key, value in pairs(props or {}) do
		inst[key] = value
	end
	for _, child in ipairs(children or {}) do
		child.Parent = inst
	end
	return inst
end

local gui = new("ScreenGui", {
	Name = "BlobControls",
	ResetOnSpawn = false,
	DisplayOrder = 5,
	Enabled = false,
})

local holder = new("Frame", {
	Name = "Holder",
	AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 1),
	Position = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 1, -16),
	Size = UDim2.new(0, 300, 0, 86),
	BackgroundTransparency = 1,
})
holder.Parent = gui

local status = new("TextLabel", {
	Name = "Status",
	AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0),
	Position = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 0, 0),
	Size = UDim2.new(0, 230, 0, 26),
	BackgroundColor3 = COLORS.panel,
	BackgroundTransparency = 0.25,
	Font = Enum.Font.GothamMedium,
	TextSize = 13,
	TextColor3 = COLORS.notEarning,
	Text = "",
}, {
	new("UICorner", { CornerRadius = UDim.new(1, 0) }),
})
status.Parent = holder

local bar = new("Frame", {
	Name = "Buttons",
	AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 1),
	Position = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 1, 0),
	Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 52),
	BackgroundColor3 = COLORS.panel,
	BackgroundTransparency = 0.15,
}, {
	new("UICorner", { CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 16) }),
	new("UIPadding", {
		PaddingTop = UDim.new(0, 6), PaddingBottom = UDim.new(0, 6),
		PaddingLeft = UDim.new(0, 6), PaddingRight = UDim.new(0, 6),
	}),
	new("UIListLayout", {
		FillDirection = Enum.FillDirection.Horizontal,
		HorizontalAlignment = Enum.HorizontalAlignment.Center,
		Padding = UDim.new(0, 6),
	}),
})
bar.Parent = holder

local function makeButton(name, text, order)
	local button = new("TextButton", {
		Name = name,
		LayoutOrder = order,
		Size = UDim2.new(0.5, -3, 1, 0),
		BackgroundColor3 = COLORS.unselected,
		AutoButtonColor = true,
		Font = Enum.Font.FredokaOne,
		TextSize = 18,
		TextColor3 = COLORS.textOff,
		Text = text,
	}, {
		new("UICorner", { CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 12) }),
	})
	button.Parent = bar
	return button
end

local followButton = makeButton("Follow", "Follow me", 1)
local farmButton = makeButton("Farm", "Stay on farm", 2)

gui.Parent = player:WaitForChild("PlayerGui")

---------------------------------------------------------------------
-- KEEP IT UP TO DATE
---------------------------------------------------------------------
local tweenInfo = TweenInfo.new(0.15)

local function paint(button, selected)
	TweenService:Create(button, tweenInfo, {
		BackgroundColor3 = selected and COLORS.selected or COLORS.unselected,
		TextColor3 = selected and COLORS.textOn or COLORS.textOff,
	}):Play()
end

local currentMode = player:GetAttribute("BlobMode") or "Follow"

local function showMode(mode)
	currentMode = mode
	paint(followButton, mode == "Follow")
	paint(farmButton, mode == "Farm")
end

local function showStatus()
	local earning = player:GetAttribute("EarningXP") == true
	status.TextColor3 = earning and COLORS.earning or COLORS.notEarning
	if earning then
		status.Text = "Earning XP on your farm"
	elseif currentMode == "Follow" then
		status.Text = "No XP off your farm"
	else
		status.Text = "Heading home..."
	end
end

local function showOrHide()
	local hasBlob = (player:GetAttribute("EquippedBlobId") or "") ~= ""
	local hatching = player:GetAttribute("Hatching") == true
	gui.Enabled = hasBlob and not hatching
end

local function choose(mode)
	if mode == currentMode then return end
	showMode(mode) -- update the buttons right away so it feels instant
	showStatus()
	setBlobMode:FireServer(mode)
end

followButton.Activated:Connect(function() choose("Follow") end)
farmButton.Activated:Connect(function() choose("Farm") end)

player:GetAttributeChangedSignal("BlobMode"):Connect(function()
	showMode(player:GetAttribute("BlobMode") or "Follow")
	showStatus()
end)

header='''--[[
	BlobSpawner (Script)
	Put this in ServerScriptService.

	Puts ALL of each player's blobs into the world:
	  • The blob chosen in the coop (EquippedBlobId) follows the player
	  • Every other blob lives on the player's farm and wanders around it
	  • Sizes each blob by level: baby size at level 1, full size at FullGrowthLevel
	  • Adds a name tag above each blob: name, level badge and an XP bar
	  • Updates tags and sizes whenever a blob levels up or gets renamed
	  • Handles the coop menu: listing blobs and choosing which one follows
	  • Removes a player's blobs when they leave

	The server only creates and sizes blobs. The BlobFollow LocalScript moves
	them on each player's screen, which keeps the movement smooth.
]]

local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local ServerScriptService = game:GetService("ServerScriptService")

local DataManager = require(ServerScriptService:WaitForChild("DataManager"))
local BlobDefinitions = require(ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("BlobDefinitions"))

local CHECK_INTERVAL = 1 -- seconds between "are the right blobs out?" checks

local COLORS = {
	tagBackground = Color3.fromRGB(24, 26, 34),
	barBackground = Color3.fromRGB(50, 54, 66),
	barFill       = Color3.fromRGB(96, 214, 120),
	levelBadge    = Color3.fromRGB(255, 196, 64),
	levelText     = Color3.fromRGB(60, 40, 0),
	text          = Color3.new(1, 1, 1),
	subText       = Color3.fromRGB(200, 205, 220),
}

-- Folder that holds every active blob in the world
local folder = workspace:FindFirstChild("ActiveBlobs")
if not folder then
	folder = Instance.new("Folder")
	folder.Name = "ActiveBlobs"
	folder.Parent = workspace
end

-- Remotes the coop menu uses
local remotes = ReplicatedStorage:FindFirstChild("Remotes")
if not remotes then
	remotes = Instance.new("Folder")
	remotes.Name = "Remotes"
	remotes.Parent = ReplicatedStorage
end

local function getRemote(name, className)
	local remote = remotes:FindFirstChild(name)
	if not remote then
		remote = Instance.new(className)
		remote.Name = name
		remote.Parent = remotes
	end
	return remote
end

local getBlobs = getRemote("GetBlobs", "RemoteFunction")
local setFollower = getRemote("SetFollower", "RemoteEvent")

local active = {} -- [player] = { [blobId] = { model, fullScale, labels } }

'''
body='''---------------------------------------------------------------------
-- SPAWNING
---------------------------------------------------------------------
local function despawnBlob(player, blobId)
	local list = active[player]
	local entry = list and list[blobId]
	if entry then
		entry.model:Destroy()
		list[blobId] = nil
	end
end

local function despawnAll(player)
	local list = active[player]
	if not list then return end
	for blobId in pairs(list) do
		despawnBlob(player, blobId)
	end
	active[player] = nil
end

-- Updates one blob's tag text, XP bar, size and attributes from its save
local function refresh(player, blobId)
	local entry = active[player] and active[player][blobId]
	if not entry then return end
	local blob = DataManager.GetBlob(player, blobId)
	if not blob then return end
	local def = BlobDefinitions.Get(blob.Type)

	-- Name and level
	local displayName = (blob.Nickname ~= "" and blob.Nickname) or (def and def.DisplayName) or blob.Type
	entry.labels.name.Text = displayName
	entry.labels.level.Text = "Lv " .. blob.Level

	-- XP bar
	if blob.Level >= BlobDefinitions.MaxLevel then
		entry.labels.fill.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 1, 0)
		entry.labels.xp.Text = "MAX"
	else
		local needed = BlobDefinitions.XPToNextLevel(blob.Level)
		local progress = math.clamp(blob.XP / needed, 0, 1)
		entry.labels.fill.Size = UDim2.new(progress, 0, 1, 0)
		entry.labels.xp.Text = ("%d / %d XP"):format(blob.XP, needed)
	end

	-- Size grows with level until fully grown
	local scale = entry.fullScale * BlobDefinitions.GetSizeScale(blob.Type, blob.Level)
	if math.abs(entry.model:GetScale() - scale) > 0.001 then
		entry.model:ScaleTo(scale)
	end
	entry.model:SetAttribute("Scale", scale) -- tells BlobFollow to re-measure it
	entry.model:SetAttribute("Level", blob.Level)
	entry.model:SetAttribute("DisplayName", displayName)
end

-- A random spot on the player's plot (or beside them if they have no plot)
local function spotOnPlot(player)
	local plotCFrame = player:GetAttribute("PlotCFrame")
	local plotSize = player:GetAttribute("PlotSize")
	if typeof(plotCFrame) == "CFrame" and typeof(plotSize) == "number" then
		local half = plotSize / 2 - 7
		return (plotCFrame * CFrame.new(
			(math.random() * 2 - 1) * half, 2, (math.random() * 2 - 1) * half)).Position
	end
	return nil
end

local function spawnBlob(player, blob, following)
	local def = BlobDefinitions.Get(blob.Type)
	local template = BlobDefinitions.GetModel(blob.Type)
	if not def or not template or not template:IsA("Model") or not template.PrimaryPart then
		warn(("[BlobSpawner] Can't spawn %s for %s: check its model in BlobModels"):format(blob.Type, player.Name))
		return
	end

	-- Where it starts: beside the player if it follows them, on the plot otherwise
	local root = player.Character and player.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
	local start
	if following and root then
		start = root.Position - root.CFrame.LookVector * 5 + root.CFrame.RightVector * 3
	else
		start = spotOnPlot(player) or (root and root.Position)
	end
	if not start then return end -- no plot and no character yet: try again next check

	local model = template:Clone()
	model.Name = player.Name .. "_" .. blob.Type
	for _, d in ipairs(model:GetDescendants()) do
		if d:IsA("BaseScript") then
			d:Destroy()
		elseif d:IsA("BasePart") then
			d.Anchored = true
			d.CanCollide = false
			d.CanTouch = false
			d.CanQuery = false
		end
	end
	-- Always loaded on every player's screen, however far away it is.
	-- (Without this, Roblox unloads it at a distance and it jumps when it comes back.)
	model.ModelStreamingMode = Enum.ModelStreamingMode.Persistent

	-- Size at which this blob is fully grown (FullSize studs tall)
	local bottom, top = BlobDefinitions.GetWorldBounds(model)
	local fullScale = model:GetScale() * (def.FullSize / math.max(top - bottom, 0.1))

	-- Info the BlobFollow LocalScript uses to move it
	model:SetAttribute("OwnerUserId", player.UserId)
	model:SetAttribute("BlobId", blob.Id)
	model:SetAttribute("BlobType", blob.Type)
	model:SetAttribute("BuiltPose", template:GetPivot().Rotation)
	model:SetAttribute("Mode", following and "Follow" or "Farm")

	model:PivotTo(CFrame.new(start) * template:GetPivot().Rotation)

	local tag, labels = buildTag(model.PrimaryPart)
	tag.Parent = model

	active[player] = active[player] or {}
	active[player][blob.Id] = {
		model = model,
		fullScale = fullScale,
		labels = labels,
	}
	refresh(player, blob.Id)
	model.Parent = folder
end

-- Makes the world match the save: every blob spawned, the right one following
local function sync(player)
	local data = DataManager.Get(player)
	if not data then return end
	local list = active[player] or {}

	-- Remove blobs the player no longer owns (or whose model got destroyed)
	for blobId, entry in pairs(list) do
		if not data.Blobs[blobId] or not entry.model.Parent then
			despawnBlob(player, blobId)
		end
	end

	-- Spawn missing blobs and set each one's mode
	for blobId, blob in pairs(data.Blobs) do
		local following = blobId == data.EquippedBlobId
		local entry = active[player] and active[player][blobId]
		if not entry then
			spawnBlob(player, blob, following)
		else
			local mode = following and "Follow" or "Farm"
			if entry.model:GetAttribute("Mode") ~= mode then
				entry.model:SetAttribute("Mode", mode)
			end
		end
	end
end

---------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Sends the player a simple list of their blobs for the coop menu
getBlobs.OnServerInvoke = function(player)
	local data = DataManager.Get(player)
	if not data then return {} end

	local list = {}
	for blobId, blob in pairs(data.Blobs) do
		local def = BlobDefinitions.Get(blob.Type)
		local maxed = blob.Level >= BlobDefinitions.MaxLevel
		table.insert(list, {
			Id = blobId,
			Type = blob.Type,
			Name = (blob.Nickname ~= "" and blob.Nickname) or (def and def.DisplayName) or blob.Type,
			Element = def and def.Element or "",
			Rarity = def and def.Rarity or "Common",
			Level = blob.Level,
			XP = blob.XP,
			XPNeeded = maxed and 0 or BlobDefinitions.XPToNextLevel(blob.Level),
			Following = blobId == data.EquippedBlobId,
		})
	end

	-- Follower first, then highest level
	table.sort(list, function(a, b)
		if a.Following ~= b.Following then return a.Following end
		if a.Level ~= b.Level then return a.Level > b.Level end
		return a.Name < b.Name
	end)
	return list

	lastChange[player] = now

	end
end)

	}).Parent = card

	local progress = info.XPNeeded > 0 and math.clamp(info.XP / info.XPNeeded, 0, 1) or 1
	local bar = new("Frame", {
		Name = "Bar",
		Position = UDim2.new(0, 72, 0, 62),
		Size = UDim2.new(1, -230, 0, 18),
		BackgroundColor3 = COLORS.barBack,
		ClipsDescendants = true,
	}, {
		new("UICorner", { CornerRadius = UDim.new(1, 0) }),
		new("Frame", {
			Name = "Fill",
			Size = UDim2.new(progress, 0, 1, 0),
			BackgroundColor3 = COLORS.barFill,
		}, {
			new("UICorner", { CornerRadius = UDim.new(1, 0) }),
		}),
		new("TextLabel", {
			BackgroundTransparency = 1,
			Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1),
			Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold,
			Text = info.XPNeeded > 0 and ("%d / %d XP"):format(info.XP, info.XPNeeded) or "MAX",
			TextColor3 = COLORS.text,
			TextStrokeTransparency = 0.5,
			TextSize = 11,
			ZIndex = 2,
		}),
	})
	bar.Parent = card

	-- Follow / send home button
	local button = new("TextButton", {
		Name = "Action",
		AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(1, 0.5),
		Position = UDim2.new(1, -12, 0.5, 0),
		Size = UDim2.new(0, 132, 0, 44),
		BackgroundColor3 = info.Following and COLORS.farm or COLORS.follow,
		Font = Enum.Font.FredokaOne,
		Text = info.Following and "Send to farm" or "Follow me",
		TextColor3 = COLORS.text,
		TextSize = 18,
	}, {
		new("UICorner", { CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 12) }),
	})
	button.Parent = card

	button.Activated:Connect(function()
		if busy then return end
		busy = true
		button.Text = "..."
		setFollower:FireServer(info.Following and "" or info.Id)
		task.wait(0.4) -- give the server a moment, then redraw
		busy = false
		refresh()
	end)

	card.Parent = list
end

refresh = function()
	if not gui.Enabled then return end
	local ok, blobs = pcall(function()
		return getBlobs:InvokeServer()
	end)
	if not ok or not gui.Enabled then return end

	-- Remember scroll position so live updates don't jump the list
	local scroll = list.CanvasPosition
	clearCards()
	if #blobs == 0 then
		new("TextLabel", {
			Name = "Empty",
			BackgroundTransparency = 1,
			Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 60),
			Font = Enum.Font.GothamMedium,
			Text = "No blobs yet. Hatch an egg to get one!",
			TextColor3 = COLORS.subText,
			TextSize = 16,
		}).Parent = list
	end
	for i, info in ipairs(blobs) do
		makeCard(info, i)
	end
	list.CanvasPosition = scroll
end

---------------------------------------------------------------------
-- OPENING AND CLOSING
---------------------------------------------------------------------
local openCount = 0

local function close()
	gui.Enabled = false
	openCount += 1 -- stops the live refresh loop
end

local function open()
	if gui.Enabled or player:GetAttribute("Hatching") == true then return end
	gui.Enabled = true
	panel.Size = UDim2.new(0, 400, 0, 380)
	TweenService:Create(panel, TweenInfo.new(0.2, Enum.EasingStyle.Back, Enum.EasingDirection.Out),
		{ Size = UDim2.new(0, 440, 0, 420) }):Play()
	refresh()

	-- Keep XP bars live while it's open
	openCount += 1
	local thisOpen = openCount
	task.spawn(function()
		while gui.Enabled and openCount == thisOpen do
			task.wait(REFRESH_EVERY)
			if gui.Enabled and openCount == thisOpen and not busy then
				refresh()
			end
		end
	end)
end

closeButton.Activated:Connect(close)

-- Is this coop on the local player's plot?
local function isMyCoop(coop)
	local plot = coop and coop.Parent
	return plot ~= nil and plot:GetAttribute("OwnerUserId") == player.UserId
end

-- Only show the "Open coop" prompt on your own coop
local function setupCoop(coop)
	local plot = coop.Parent
	local prompt = coop:FindFirstChild("OpenCoop", true)
	local clicker = coop:FindFirstChild("CoopClick")
	local function update()
		local mine = isMyCoop(coop)
		if prompt then prompt.Enabled = mine end
		if clicker then clicker.MaxActivationDistance = mine and 40 or 0 end
	end
	plot:GetAttributeChangedSignal("OwnerUserId"):Connect(update)
	update()

	if clicker then
		clicker.MouseClick:Connect(function(who)
			if who == player and isMyCoop(coop) then open() end
		end)
	end
end

ProximityPromptService.PromptTriggered:Connect(function(prompt)
	if prompt.Name == "OpenCoop" then
		local coop = prompt:FindFirstAncestor("Coop")
		if isMyCoop(coop) then open() end
	end
end)

local function watchPlot(plot)
	local coop = plot:WaitForChild("Coop", 10)
	if coop then setupCoop(coop) end
end
plotMap.ChildAdded:Connect(watchPlot)
for _, plot in ipairs(plotMap:GetChildren()) do
	task.spawn(watchPlot, plot)
end

player:GetAttributeChangedSignal("Hatching"):Connect(function()
	if player:GetAttribute("Hatching") == true then close() end
end)

	Put this in StarterPlayer > StarterPlayerScripts.

	A little red barn button on the left of the screen shows the blob that's
	following you. Click it to open the Blob Coop:
	  • Every blob you own gets a card with a 3D picture, its name, element,
	    level and XP bar
	  • Click a blob's card to make it follow you
	  • Click your current follower's card to send it home to the farm
	Blobs on the farm wander your plot and earn XP; your follower only earns
	while you're on your plot.
]]

local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local TweenService = game:GetService("TweenService")

local BlobDefinitions = require(ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("BlobDefinitions"))
local remotes = ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("Remotes")
local getBlobs = remotes:WaitForChild("GetBlobs")
local setFollower = remotes:WaitForChild("SetFollower")

local player = Players.LocalPlayer
local activeBlobs = workspace:WaitForChild("ActiveBlobs")

---------------------------------------------------------------------
-- SETTINGS
---------------------------------------------------------------------
local REFRESH_EVERY = 2 -- seconds between XP updates while the coop is open

local COLORS = {
	barn       = Color3.fromRGB(186, 58, 46),
	barnDark   = Color3.fromRGB(140, 40, 32),
	trim       = Color3.fromRGB(250, 244, 230),
	wood       = Color3.fromRGB(133, 88, 56),
	woodLine   = Color3.fromRGB(110, 72, 45),
	card       = Color3.fromRGB(250, 243, 228),
	ink        = Color3.fromRGB(64, 40, 24),
	inkSoft    = Color3.fromRGB(130, 104, 84),
	barBack    = Color3.fromRGB(222, 210, 188),
	barFill    = Color3.fromRGB(96, 200, 110),
	level      = Color3.fromRGB(255, 196, 64),
	follow     = Color3.fromRGB(70, 190, 95),
	white      = Color3.new(1, 1, 1),
}

-- Card colors for each element
local ELEMENT_COLORS = {
	Grass    = Color3.fromRGB(92, 180, 72),
	Ice      = Color3.fromRGB(110, 190, 235),
	Electric = Color3.fromRGB(240, 196, 40),
	Fire     = Color3.fromRGB(235, 110, 50),
	Water    = Color3.fromRGB(60, 130, 220),
	Wind     = Color3.fromRGB(140, 205, 190),

local function new(className, props, children)
	local inst = Instance.new(className)
	for key, value in pairs(props or {}) do
		inst[key] = value
	end
	for _, child in ipairs(children or {}) do
		child.Parent = inst
	end
	return inst
end

local function corner(radius)
	return new("UICorner", { CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, radius) })

local function stroke(color, thickness)
	return new("UIStroke", { Color = color, Thickness = thickness, ApplyStrokeMode = Enum.ApplyStrokeMode.Border })
end

-- A 3D picture of a blob, facing the camera
local function makePreview(blobType, parent)
	local viewport = new("ViewportFrame", {
		Name = "Preview",
		BackgroundTransparency = 1,
		Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1),
		Ambient = Color3.fromRGB(175, 175, 175),
		LightColor = Color3.new(1, 1, 1),
		LightDirection = Vector3.new(-0.4, -1, 0.6),
	})

	local template = blobType and BlobDefinitions.GetModel(blobType)
	if template and template:IsA("Model") then
		local model = template:Clone()
		for _, d in ipairs(model:GetDescendants()) do
			if d:IsA("BaseScript") then
				d:Destroy()
			elseif d:IsA("BasePart") then
				d.Anchored = true
			end
		end
		-- Same pose the blob uses in the world, facing the camera
		model:PivotTo(BlobDefinitions.GetFacingRotation(blobType) * template:GetPivot().Rotation)
		model.Parent = viewport

		local boxCFrame, boxSize = model:GetBoundingBox()
		local radius = math.max(boxSize.Magnitude / 2, 0.5)
		local camera = new("Camera", { FieldOfView = 35 })
		camera.CFrame = CFrame.lookAt(
			boxCFrame.Position + Vector3.new(0, radius * 0.35, -radius * 2.9),
			boxCFrame.Position)
		camera.Parent = viewport
		viewport.CurrentCamera = camera
	end

	viewport.Parent = parent
	return viewport
end

local function hoverGrow(button, target)
	local uiScale = new("UIScale", { Scale = 1 })
	uiScale.Parent = target
	local info = TweenInfo.new(0.12)
	button.MouseEnter:Connect(function()
		TweenService:Create(uiScale, info, { Scale = 1.05 }):Play()
	end)
	button.MouseLeave:Connect(function()
		TweenService:Create(uiScale, info, { Scale = 1 }):Play()
	end)
end

local function updateCard(card, info, order)
	card.info = info
	card.button.LayoutOrder = order
	card.name.Text = info.Name
	card.level.Text = "Lv " .. info.Level

	local progress = info.XPNeeded > 0 and math.clamp(info.XP / info.XPNeeded, 0, 1) or 1
	card.fill.Size = UDim2.new(progress, 0, 1, 0)
	card.xp.Text = info.XPNeeded > 0 and ("%d / %d XP"):format(info.XP, info.XPNeeded) or "MAX LEVEL"

	card.ribbon.Visible = info.Following
	card.border.Color = info.Following and COLORS.follow or card.elementColor
	card.border.Thickness = info.Following and 4 or 2
	card.status.Text = info.Following and "Click to send home" or "Click to follow you"
	card.status.TextColor3 = info.Following and COLORS.follow or COLORS.inkSoft
end

refresh = function()
	if not panel.Visible then return end
	local ok, blobs = pcall(function()
		return getBlobs:InvokeServer()
	end)
	if not ok or not panel.Visible then return end

	local seen = {}
	for order, info in ipairs(blobs) do
		seen[info.Id] = true
		local card = cards[info.Id] or makeCard(info)
		cards[info.Id] = card
		updateCard(card, info, order)
	end
	for blobId, card in pairs(cards) do
		if not seen[blobId] then
			card.button:Destroy()
			cards[blobId] = nil
		end
	end
	emptyLabel.Visible = #blobs == 0
end

---------------------------------------------------------------------
-- OPENING AND CLOSING
---------------------------------------------------------------------
local openCount = 0

local function close()
	if not panel.Visible then return end
	openCount += 1 -- stops the live refresh loop
	panel.Visible = false
end

local function open()
	if player:GetAttribute("Hatching") == true then return end
	panel.Visible = true
	panel.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 0.5, 60)
	TweenService:Create(panel, TweenInfo.new(0.25, Enum.EasingStyle.Back, Enum.EasingDirection.Out),
		{ Position = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 0.5, 30) }):Play()
	refresh()

	-- Keep XP bars live while it's open
	openCount += 1
	local thisOpen = openCount
	task.spawn(function()
		while panel.Visible and openCount == thisOpen do
			task.wait(REFRESH_EVERY)
			if panel.Visible and openCount == thisOpen and not busy then
				refresh()
			end
		end
	end)
end

barnClick.Activated:Connect(function()
	if panel.Visible then close() else open() end
end)
closeButton.Activated:Connect(close)

input.content:
--[[
	FarmStations (Script)
	Put this in ServerScriptService.

	Builds and runs each player's farm stations:

	  BERRY GARDEN (outside the plot, in front of the fence left of the gate)
	    • 4 bush spots. Players start with 1 bush.
	    • The next spot shows a green pad with its price. Step on it to buy.
	    • Each bush grows 1 berry every GROW_TIME seconds, up to BERRIES_PER_BUSH,
	      even while the player is offline. Press E / tap to pick them.

	  FEEDER (inside the plot, along that same fence)
	    • Press E / tap to put all carried berries into the trough.
	    • Blobs living on the farm walk over, eat a berry and gain BERRY_XP.

	Also sends short pop-up messages (like "Not enough coins") through
	Remotes > Notify, shown by the FarmHud LocalScript.
]]

local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local ServerScriptService = game:GetService("ServerScriptService")

local DataManager = require(ServerScriptService:WaitForChild("DataManager"))

---------------------------------------------------------------------
-- SETTINGS
---------------------------------------------------------------------
local BUSH_PRICES      = { 0, 50, 200, 500 } -- cost of bush 1, 2, 3, 4 (bush 1 is free)
local GROW_TIME        = 30   -- seconds to grow one berry
local BERRIES_PER_BUSH = 5    -- most berries a bush can hold

local FEEDER_MAX       = 30   -- most berries the feeder holds
local BERRY_XP         = 30   -- XP a blob gets for eating one berry
local EAT_COOLDOWN     = 25   -- seconds before the same blob eats again
local EAT_TIME         = 9    -- seconds to walk to the feeder and eat
local FEED_CHECK       = 3    -- seconds between "who's hungry?" checks

-- Must match PlotManager
local GATE_WIDTH       = 16
local PLATFORM_TOP     = 0.95 -- height of the grey platform (plot-relative)
local GRASS_TOP        = 1    -- height of the plot's grass (plot-relative)

local COLORS = {
	wood      = Color3.fromRGB(150, 104, 66),
	woodDark  = Color3.fromRGB(105, 70, 44),
	dirt      = Color3.fromRGB(102, 72, 50),
	bush      = Color3.fromRGB(58, 140, 62),
	bushDark  = Color3.fromRGB(42, 110, 48),
	berry     = Color3.fromRGB(214, 36, 60),
	buyPad    = Color3.fromRGB(80, 220, 110),
	text      = Color3.new(1, 1, 1),
}

---------------------------------------------------------------------
-- SETUP
---------------------------------------------------------------------
local folder = workspace:FindFirstChild("FarmStations")
if not folder then
	folder = Instance.new("Folder")
	folder.Name = "FarmStations"
	folder.Parent = workspace
end

local remotes = ReplicatedStorage:FindFirstChild("Remotes")
if not remotes then
	remotes = Instance.new("Folder")
	remotes.Name = "Remotes"
	remotes.Parent = ReplicatedStorage
end
local notify = remotes:FindFirstChild("Notify")
if not notify then
	notify = Instance.new("RemoteEvent")
	notify.Name = "Notify"
	notify.Parent = remotes
end

local function message(player, text, kind)
	notify:FireClient(player, text, kind or "info")
end

local stations = {} -- [player] = { model, plotCFrame, bushes = {}, pad, feeder parts }
local lastAte = {}  -- [blobId] = os.time() it last ate
local busyBuying = {}

---------------------------------------------------------------------
-- BUILD HELPERS
---------------------------------------------------------------------
local function part(props)
	local p = Instance.new("Part")
	p.Anchored = true
	p.TopSurface = Enum.SurfaceType.Smooth
	p.BottomSurface = Enum.SurfaceType.Smooth
	for key, value in pairs(props) do
		if key ~= "Parent" then p[key] = value end
	end
	p.Parent = props.Parent
	return p
end

local function billboard(adornee, text, offsetY, width)
	local gui = Instance.new("BillboardGui")
	gui.Name = "Label"
	gui.Size = UDim2.new(0, width or 160, 0, 40)
	gui.StudsOffsetWorldSpace = Vector3.new(0, offsetY, 0)
	gui.LightInfluence = 0
	gui.MaxDistance = 70
	gui.Adornee = adornee
	local label = Instance.new("TextLabel")
	label.Name = "Text"
	label.Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1)
	label.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	label.Font = Enum.Font.FredokaOne
	label.TextScaled = true
	label.TextColor3 = COLORS.text
	label.TextStrokeTransparency = 0.3
	label.Text = text
	label.Parent = gui
	gui.Parent = adornee
	return label
end

local function prompt(parent, action, object, ownerId)
	local p = Instance.new("ProximityPrompt")
	p.ActionText = action
	p.ObjectText = object
	p.HoldDuration = 0
	p.MaxActivationDistance = 10
	p.RequiresLineOfSight = false
	p:SetAttribute("OwnerUserId", ownerId) -- FarmHud hides prompts that aren't yours
	p.Parent = parent
	return p
end

-- Positions along the front fence, left of the gate (plot-local X)
local function frontLeftRange(plotSize)
	local half = plotSize / 2
	return -half, -(GATE_WIDTH / 2 + 2) -- from the corner to the gate pillar
end

---------------------------------------------------------------------
-- BERRY BUSHES
---------------------------------------------------------------------
local function berriesReady(data, index)
	local started = data.Farm.BushTimers[index] or os.time()
	return math.clamp(math.floor((os.time() - started) / GROW_TIME), 0, BERRIES_PER_BUSH)
end

-- Plot-local spot for bush number `index`, outside the plot in front of the fence
local function bushSpot(plotSize, index)
	local left, right = frontLeftRange(plotSize)
	local spacing = (right - left) / 4
	local x = left + spacing * (index - 0.5)
	local z = -plotSize / 2 - 6
	return x, z
end

local BERRY_OFFSETS = {
	Vector3.new(0.9, 0.9, -1.3), Vector3.new(-1.2, 0.5, -1.0), Vector3.new(0.2, 1.5, -1.0),
	Vector3.new(1.4, 0.2, 0.4), Vector3.new(-1.0, 1.1, 0.9),
}

local function buildBush(player, st, index)
	local x, z = bushSpot(st.plotSize, index)
	local base = st.plotCFrame * CFrame.new(x, PLATFORM_TOP, z)
	local bushModel = Instance.new("Model")
	bushModel.Name = "Bush" .. index

	part({ Name = "Dirt", Size = Vector3.new(4.6, 0.4, 4.6), CFrame = base * CFrame.new(0, 0.2, 0),
		Color = COLORS.dirt, Material = Enum.Material.Ground, Parent = bushModel })
	local leaves = part({ Name = "Leaves", Shape = Enum.PartType.Ball, Size = Vector3.new(3.6, 3.6, 3.6),
		CFrame = base * CFrame.new(0, 2.2, 0), Color = COLORS.bush, Material = Enum.Material.Grass,
		CanCollide = true, Parent = bushModel })
	part({ Name = "Leaves2", Shape = Enum.PartType.Ball, Size = Vector3.new(2.4, 2.4, 2.4),
		CFrame = base * CFrame.new(1, 1.5, 0.6), Color = COLORS.bushDark, Material = Enum.Material.Grass,
		Parent = bushModel })
	part({ Name = "Leaves3", Shape = Enum.PartType.Ball, Size = Vector3.new(2.4, 2.4, 2.4),
		CFrame = base * CFrame.new(-1, 1.5, -0.4), Color = COLORS.bushDark, Material = Enum.Material.Grass,
		Parent = bushModel })

	local berries = {}
	for i, offset in ipairs(BERRY_OFFSETS) do
		berries[i] = part({ Name = "Berry", Shape = Enum.PartType.Ball, Size = Vector3.new(0.7, 0.7, 0.7),
			CFrame = base * CFrame.new(Vector3.new(0, 2.2, 0) + offset), Color = COLORS.berry,
			Material = Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic, CanCollide = false, Parent = bushModel })
	end

	local pick = prompt(leaves, "Pick berries", "Berry Bush", player.UserId)
	pick.Triggered:Connect(function(who)
		if who ~= player then return end
		local data = DataManager.Get(player)
		if not data then return end
		local ready = berriesReady(data, index)
		if ready == 0 then
			message(player, "Not ripe yet. A berry grows every " .. GROW_TIME .. " seconds.")
			return
		end
		-- Keep any partly grown berry's progress, unless the bush was full
		local now = os.time()
		local started = data.Farm.BushTimers[index] or now
		if ready >= BERRIES_PER_BUSH then
			data.Farm.BushTimers[index] = now
		else
			data.Farm.BushTimers[index] = started + ready * GROW_TIME
		end
		data.Farm.Berries += ready
		player:SetAttribute("Berries", data.Farm.Berries)
		message(player, ("+%d berries"):format(ready), "good")
	end)

	bushModel.Parent = st.model
	st.bushes[index] = { model = bushModel, berries = berries, prompt = pick }
end

---------------------------------------------------------------------
-- BUY PAD (only the next bush spot shows one)
---------------------------------------------------------------------
local refreshStations -- defined below

local function buildBuyPad(player, st, index)
	local x, z = bushSpot(st.plotSize, index)
	local price = BUSH_PRICES[index]
	local pad = part({
		Name = "BuyPad", Size = Vector3.new(4.2, 0.3, 4.2),
		CFrame = st.plotCFrame * CFrame.new(x, PLATFORM_TOP + 0.15, z),
		Color = COLORS.buyPad, Material = Enum.Material.Neon, Transparency = 0.15,
		CanCollide = false, Parent = st.model,
	})
	billboard(pad, ("Berry Bush\n%d coins"):format(price), 3, 140)

	pad.Touched:Connect(function(hit)
		local character = hit:FindFirstAncestorOfClass("Model")
		if not character or Players:GetPlayerFromCharacter(character) ~= player then return end
		if busyBuying[player] then return end
		busyBuying[player] = true

		local data = DataManager.Get(player)
		if data and data.Farm.BushPlots == index - 1 then
			if DataManager.SpendCoins(player, price) then
				data.Farm.BushPlots = index
				data.Farm.BushTimers[index] = os.time()
				message(player, "New berry bush planted!", "good")
				task.spawn(DataManager.Save, player)
				refreshStations(player)
			else
				message(player, ("You need %d coins (you have %d)"):format(price, data.Coins), "bad")
			end
		end

		task.wait(2) -- so standing on it doesn't spam messages
		busyBuying[player] = nil
	end)

	st.pad = pad
end

---------------------------------------------------------------------
-- FEEDER (inside the plot along the front-left fence)
---------------------------------------------------------------------
local function feederInfo(plotSize)
	local left, right = frontLeftRange(plotSize)
	local length = (right - left) - 3
	local centerX = (left + right) / 2
	local z = -plotSize / 2 + 2 -- just inside the fence
	return centerX, z, length
end

local function buildFeeder(player, st)
	local centerX, z, length = feederInfo(st.plotSize)
	local base = st.plotCFrame * CFrame.new(centerX, GRASS_TOP, z)
	local feeder = Instance.new("Model")
	feeder.Name = "Feeder"

	local bottom = part({ Name = "Bottom", Size = Vector3.new(length, 0.4, 2.4), CFrame = base * CFrame.new(0, 0.6, 0),
		Color = COLORS.woodDark, Material = Enum.Material.WoodPlanks, Parent = feeder })
	for _, side in ipairs({ -1, 1 }) do
		part({ Name = "Side", Size = Vector3.new(length, 1.4, 0.3), CFrame = base * CFrame.new(0, 1.1, side * 1.05),
			Color = COLORS.wood, Material = Enum.Material.WoodPlanks, Parent = feeder })
		part({ Name = "End", Size = Vector3.new(0.3, 1.4, 2.4), CFrame = base * CFrame.new(side * (length / 2 - 0.15), 1.1, 0),
			Color = COLORS.wood, Material = Enum.Material.WoodPlanks, Parent = feeder })
		part({ Name = "Leg", Size = Vector3.new(0.5, 0.4, 2.4), CFrame = base * CFrame.new(side * (length / 2 - 1), 0.2, 0),
			Color = COLORS.woodDark, Material = Enum.Material.Wood, Parent = feeder })
	end

	-- Berries shown in the trough (up to 15 visible)
	local shown = {}
	for i = 1, 15 do
		local t = (i - 0.5) / 15
		shown[i] = part({ Name = "Berry", Shape = Enum.PartType.Ball, Size = Vector3.new(0.7, 0.7, 0.7),
			CFrame = base * CFrame.new(-length / 2 + 0.8 + t * (length - 1.6), 1.15, (i % 2 == 0) and 0.35 or -0.35),
			Color = COLORS.berry, Material = Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic, CanCollide = false,
			Transparency = 1, Parent = feeder })
	end

	local label = billboard(bottom, "Feeder 0 / " .. FEEDER_MAX, 3.2, 170)

	local fill = prompt(bottom, "Add berries", "Feeder", player.UserId)
	fill.MaxActivationDistance = 12
	fill.Triggered:Connect(function(who)
		if who ~= player then return end
		local data = DataManager.Get(player)
		if not data then return end
		if data.Farm.Berries <= 0 then
			message(player, "You have no berries. Pick some from your bushes!")
			return
		end
		local space = FEEDER_MAX - data.Farm.FeederBerries
		if space <= 0 then
			message(player, "The feeder is full!")
			return
		end
		local moved = math.min(space, data.Farm.Berries)
		data.Farm.Berries -= moved
		data.Farm.FeederBerries += moved
		player:SetAttribute("Berries", data.Farm.Berries)
		message(player, ("Added %d berries to the feeder"):format(moved), "good")
		refreshStations(player)
	end)

	feeder.Parent = st.model
	st.feeder = { model = feeder, berries = shown, label = label, centerX = centerX, z = z, length = length }
end

---------------------------------------------------------------------
-- KEEP VISUALS UP TO DATE
---------------------------------------------------------------------
refreshStations = function(player)
	local st = stations[player]
	local data = DataManager.Get(player)
	if not st or not data then return end

	-- Build bushes the player owns but don't exist yet
	for index = 1, math.min(data.Farm.BushPlots, #BUSH_PRICES) do
		if not st.bushes[index] then
			data.Farm.BushTimers[index] = data.Farm.BushTimers[index] or os.time()
			buildBush(player, st, index)
		end
	end

	-- Show the buy pad for the next spot only
	local nextIndex = data.Farm.BushPlots + 1
	if st.pad and st.padIndex ~= nextIndex then
		st.pad:Destroy()
		st.pad = nil
	end
	if not st.pad and nextIndex <= #BUSH_PRICES then
		buildBuyPad(player, st, nextIndex)
		st.padIndex = nextIndex
	end

	-- Berries on each bush
	for index, bush in pairs(st.bushes) do
		local ready = berriesReady(data, index)
		for i, berry in ipairs(bush.berries) do
			berry.Transparency = i <= ready and 0 or 1
		end
		bush.prompt.ObjectText = ("Berry Bush (%d/%d)"):format(ready, BERRIES_PER_BUSH)
	end

	-- Feeder
	local inFeeder = data.Farm.FeederBerries
	local visible = math.ceil(inFeeder / FEEDER_MAX * #st.feeder.berries)
	for i, berry in ipairs(st.feeder.berries) do
		berry.Transparency = i <= visible and 0 or 1
	end
	st.feeder.label.Text = ("Feeder %d / %d"):format(inFeeder, FEEDER_MAX)
end

local function buildStations(player)
	local plotCFrame = player:GetAttribute("PlotCFrame")
	local plotSize = player:GetAttribute("PlotSize")
	if typeof(plotCFrame) ~= "CFrame" or typeof(plotSize) ~= "number" then return end

	local model = Instance.new("Model")
	model.Name = player.Name .. "_Farm"
	model.ModelStreamingMode = Enum.ModelStreamingMode.Persistent

	local st = {
		model = model,
		plotCFrame = plotCFrame,
		plotSize = plotSize,
		bushes = {},
	}
	stations[player] = st
	buildFeeder(player, st)
	refreshStations(player)
	model.Parent = folder

	local data = DataManager.Get(player)
	player:SetAttribute("Berries", data and data.Farm.Berries or 0)
end

local function removeStations(player)
	local st = stations[player]
	if st then
		st.model:Destroy()
		stations[player] = nil
	end
end

---------------------------------------------------------------------
-- FEEDING: farm blobs walk to the feeder and eat
---------------------------------------------------------------------
local function feedBlobs(player)
	local st = stations[player]
	local data = DataManager.Get(player)
	if not st or not data or data.Farm.FeederBerries <= 0 then return end

	local blobFolder = workspace:FindFirstChild("ActiveBlobs")
	if not blobFolder then return end
	local now = os.time()

	for _, model in ipairs(blobFolder:GetChildren()) do
		if data.Farm.FeederBerries <= 0 then break end
		local blobId = model:GetAttribute("BlobId")
		if model:GetAttribute("OwnerUserId") == player.UserId
			and model:GetAttribute("Mode") == "Farm"
			and model:GetAttribute("GoEat") == nil
			and blobId and data.Blobs[blobId]
			and (not lastAte[blobId] or now - lastAte[blobId] >= EAT_COOLDOWN) then

			-- Save the berry for this blob, and send it to a spot along the trough
			data.Farm.FeederBerries -= 1
			lastAte[blobId] = now
			local f = st.feeder
			local x = f.centerX + (math.random() - 0.5) * (f.length - 3)
			local spot = (st.plotCFrame * CFrame.new(x, GRASS_TOP, f.z + 3.2)).Position
			model:SetAttribute("GoEat", spot)
			model:SetAttribute("EatFacing", st.plotCFrame.LookVector) -- face the fence
			refreshStations(player)

			task.delay(EAT_TIME, function()
				if model.Parent then
					model:SetAttribute("GoEat", nil)
					model:SetAttribute("EatFacing", nil)
				end
				if player.Parent and DataManager.GetBlob(player, blobId) then
					DataManager.AddXP(player, blobId, BERRY_XP)
				elseif player.Parent then
					-- The blob went away before eating: put the berry back
					local d = DataManager.Get(player)

local function new(className, props, children)

	end

end

One assumption: blobs eat the best berries in the feeder first. Tell me if you'd rather it go in another order.
